tools.name: agent_get_state
tools.title: Get MCMCP State
tools.description: Returns lightweight policy-filtered player essentials and all nine hotbar slots without opening inventory. Detailed v1-compatible sections are returned only when named in sections. known_menu exposes a single-use operation_ref for a current synchronized menu; never infer raw slots. merchant_offers is present only for the current merchant screen and returns typed facts, never raw slots, components, NBT, lore, or display text. query plus max_results adds a bounded client-known recipe result. It never scans hidden world data.

ready_expires_at.description: Schema v1 compatibility field; always null because READY does not expire

session_id.description: Opaque current loaded-world session identity, changed on world/session replacement. Not a persistent save ID. Durable clients require this field and must reject its absence or a changed identity until explicitly rebound with fresh observations.

placement_materials.description: Own-inventory construction sources. Only actually held default-component, normally sized Vanilla BlockItem stacks whose existing construction policy admits one unique property-free full-cube state are included. Counts include only qualifying stacks. Copy placement_state_ref after successful response delivery; it shares the session-local 512-identity store with visible_surface refs and survives coordinate TTL. This supplies material identity only; support/target/pose and server confirmation stay current. Directional, partial, dynamic, custom-component and MOD items are omitted; use eligible visible_surface sources for other supported states.

standard_potions.description: Own-inventory projection only. Validates component-exact unmodified Vanilla singleton potion stacks, then groups them by item+potion across slots; impossible overstacks, custom color/effects/name/lore, or any other nonstandard component are omitted rather than exposed.

entity_attack_consent.description: Read-only summary of one runtime-owned bounded kill-zone consent. Pending is never attack authority. MCP 2026-07-28 clients declaring form elicitation receive client-side input_required approval with no Minecraft prompt or consent input lock; unsupported clients fall back to the local physical Grant screen and a 3600-tick (3-minute), single-consume start token. Each path is bound to exactly one finite operate_kill_zone Action, not one entity and not a reusable cross-Action lease. The Action-owned duration starts only after approval consumption and is capped at 35990 ticks; sustained jobs should normally request at least 3600 ticks or a potion/equipment window. Current targets and newly spawned mobs matching the approved types may be attacked until the finite count, operation deadline, or a hard safety gate ends the Action. Per-target entity_ref is deliberately excluded. The consumer JIT proves fresh target, whole AABB containment, LOS, reach, crosshair, cooldown, structure, collateral safety, and effective health before every dispatch. Decline, cancel, Esc/emergency stop, OFF, world/session change, endpoint fault, shutdown, or effective-health decrease revokes authority.

merchant_offers.description: Optional exact-current-screen projection. Omitted unless the visible MerchantScreen, player menu, world session, container ID, and open-packet revision all match the latest inbound merchant-offers packet.

max_distance_blocks.description: Public Action distance-budget hard maximum. Route search separately reserves bounded start-pose uncertainty before admitting a path.

latest_frame_id.description: Handle announced by agent_get_state; retained for up to 60 idle seconds subject to the 16-handle cap

visible_surface.description: Number of deliverable unique visible block positions after representative-face compaction

tools.name: agent_get_mcp_status
tools.title: Get MCMCP Status
tools.description: Returns compact MCP control and correlation metadata without player or inventory state. Reports the current control mode, pause state, nullable READY expiry, world session, latest observation frame, and currently running action. Null IDs mean that no corresponding world, frame, or running action exists.

ready_expires_at.description: Absolute client tick when READY expires, or null while READY has no expiry or is not active

tools.name: agent_get_observation
tools.title: Get MCMCP Observation
tools.description: With no arguments, atomically pins and returns the latest observation frame, up to 64 compact block, entity, and hazard records. Entity and hazard summaries omit motion, bounds, and per-record evidence; explicit queries retain those fields. Compact blocks group only actually visible faces by position plus block/state and encode faces with D/U/N/S/W/E; they never imply unseen faces or air. The default omits traversability, unknown_boundary, and sound_clue records; absence never means air. For precise evidence or paging, pass schema_version=1, an announced frame_id, kinds, cursor=null on the first page, limit=1..256, and optional filter; explicit queries retain detailed visible_surface and traversability records. Filters only narrow already visible records and do not scan unseen world state. If a frame expires, call with no arguments to read the newest frame.

positionBounds.description: One inclusive integer block-coordinate box in one dimension. This is a delivery-only filter over the selected frame, not an observation center or radius.

completeBlockState.description: Complete registered runtime BlockState. properties contains every property defined by block; property-free blocks use an empty object.

worldBounds.description: Ordered continuous AABB in one dimension; runtime additionally limits each axis span to 64 blocks.

visibleSurface.description: One deterministic representative visible face for this block position; UP is preferred over horizontal faces, which are preferred over DOWN. state is the complete runtime BlockState only for the closed construction copy/support and furnace-family target allowlist (copyable blocks plus minecraft:dirt, minecraft:grass_block, minecraft:obsidian, minecraft:furnace, minecraft:blast_furnace, and minecraft:smoker), and null otherwise so hidden properties are not disclosed. placement_item is the ordinary inventory item that may reproduce a non-null state through the closed placement adapter. placement_state_ref is its bounded, session-local opaque memory identity; it is null when the surface is not eligible for safe copy placement.

compactBlock.description: Argument-free projection grouped only from returned visible_surface records with the same position, block, and nullable audited state. faces contains only witnessed faces using D/U/N/S/W/E; omitted faces and positions remain unknown, never air. Server-side delivery evidence retains the full witnessed surface metadata.

entity_ref.description: Nullable for players or when safe issuance failed. A non-null value is a 24-character opaque reference issued only from this current visual entity sample. It is bound server-side to the exact world session, dimension, registry type, and internal entity identity, resolves for at most 100 client ticks after the latest visible observation, and never exposes the UUID. Reobserve after expiry; the ref alone never proves current visibility or authorizes an operation.

displayed_item.description: Present only for a visible minecraft:item entity; registry identity of its rendered non-empty ItemStack. Stack count, components, UUID, owner, pickup delay, and age are intentionally omitted.

frame_display.description: Present only when the front display face of a Vanilla item_frame or glow_item_frame is currently visible under fog and LOS policy. item is null for an observed empty frame; absence of frame_display means unknown, never empty. rotation is the rendered 0..7 rotation. aim_point is the witnessed front-face point. This works independently of container_label, including frames near double chests. Copy entity_ref and the expected item into the frame-item Action; reobserve between removal, pickup, and insertion.

container_label.description: Present only for a visible non-empty minecraft:item_frame or minecraft:glow_item_frame directly attached to one policy-visible single wooden/copper chest or barrel face. It links the rendered registry item to the exact container block without exposing count, components, NBT, or UUID. Double chests are omitted in this initial slice. Copy the record entity_ref and container_label.item into routing_label; the runtime rechecks the same visible frame, item, attachment, and target before every open or transfer click.

compactVisibleEntity.description: Argument-free summary; request an explicit visible_entity page for motion, bounds, and per-record evidence.

navigation_target.description: Exact integer player feet-space cell accepted by navigate_to_known.target; copy without rounding from/to. A standalone navigation to a freshly returned target is distance-admissible with the public maximum max_distance_blocks=32 when the starting pose remains inside its bounded cell envelope.

compactHazard.description: Argument-free hazard summary; request an explicit hazard page for per-record evidence.

tools.name: agent_move
tools.title: Move to Coordinates
tools.description: Moves over locally known safe routes. clear_path defaults to false; when true, a blocked route may break ordinary visible blocks and, only with bridge_block, fill adjacent floor gaps. Each change needs server confirmation and fresh route evidence. stop_when ends early on a visible block, own item count, position, or screen condition. Unknown cells are never assumed safe.

tools.name: agent_break_block
tools.title: Break Blocks
tools.description: Breaks one cell or a signed inclusive box of Vanilla blocks. Filters are optional; advance approaches through known safe cells and confirms each break. Never replays an uncertain mutation.

tools.name: agent_place_block
tools.title: Place Blocks
tools.description: Places a Vanilla block at one cell or over a signed inclusive box. Desired properties and replace filter are optional. Uses local support evidence and server confirmation. Beds, doors and double plants validate and confirm both cells; confirmed_count counts placements, and confirmed_cells includes companions. Existing matching placements are reported separately in observed_cells. Companion cells may lie just outside the anchor region.

tools.name: agent_interact
tools.title: Interact
tools.description: Uses a block, held item, observed entity, or coordinate menu through ordinary game input. Blocks and entities can be approached with advance (default true); entities must remain visible and valid. Menu operations atomically open, inspect, optionally shift-click whole stacks in Vanilla generic chest/dispenser, hopper or shulker storage menus under exact slot/item/count conditions, then close. Menu crafting output, partial transfers, cursor pickup and custom buttons are not supported. Job results distinguish accepted use from server-confirmed effects.

result_item.description: Optional postcondition: require a fresh server-confirmed item ID in the selected slot after use.

max_ticks.description: Must exceed hold_ticks. Default is max(200, hold_ticks+80).

item.description: Optional inventory item; minecraft:air selects an empty slot.

result_item.description: Optional postcondition: require a fresh server-confirmed item ID in the selected slot after use.

tools.name: agent_inventory
tools.title: Inspect and Move Inventory
tools.description: Inspects, swaps or drops player inventory. With target=container and x/y/z, approaches a chest, barrel or copper chest. With target=storage and storage_slot, opens a carried storage item through its supported provider. Inspect reads contents; transfer takes or stores an exact count. Mutations require server confirmation and retain partial results on cancellation. Current transfers require a plan within 14 pickup clicks.

tools.name: agent_click
tools.title: Click in World
tools.description: Issues finite left, right, or middle mouse input. An optional exact block or observed entity_ref guards the current crosshair and reach; this low-level tool does not prove a semantic world effect.

tools.name: agent_input_sequence
tools.title: Run Finite Input Sequence
tools.description: Runs bounded logical keys and mouse actions in simultaneous or sequential steps. Releases all owned input on completion, cancellation, and safety stop. stop_when supports position, currently visible block state, own inventory count, and screen type; unknown blocks never satisfy a condition.

tools.name: agent_run_script
tools.title: Run Restricted Action Script
tools.description: Runs a bounded synchronous JavaScript-like action script with keyword arguments, variables, functions, branches, and finite loops. No host, file, network, module, async, or arbitrary Java access.

tools.name: agent_get_action
tools.title: Get MCMCP Action
tools.description: For v2 jobs, returns kind, state, progress, cancellation and failure; include_result=true adds the bounded result when needed. Legacy v1 Actions: returns bounded progress, a policy-filtered trace, a bounded latest-effect ring (monotonic seq; earlier entries may be evicted) with terminal aggregate, terminal partial/resume metadata, and the bounded canonical JSON source/hash for one explicit action handle. A confirmed effect has server-derived before/after evidence; unknown means a mutation was dispatched without a confirmed after-state and requires reobservation, never blind replay. Failed or cancelled terminal does not roll back confirmed effects: apply each confirmed effect exactly once. recoverable never authorizes replaying the same Action; when partial.resume_requires_reobservation is true, fetch fresh state or observation and plan a new Action. source is audit data, not replay authority. template is identical only when no opaque reference exists; otherwise every opaque ref and its coupled recipe fingerprint are null, ready_for_agent_start_action=false, and reference_requirements says how to refresh them. Opaque refs are never declared live by this off-client-thread read and must always be refreshed before cloning. wait_timeout_ms is an optional integer from 0 through 25000; zero or omission returns immediately, otherwise it waits off the Minecraft client thread until terminal or timeout. Set include_container_results=true to return complete item-ID totals from successful inspect_known_container nodes (up to 54 types per container, component differences aggregated). container_results_limit is 1..8 (default 4); pass next_cursor as container_results_cursor with include_container_results=true for more containers. Cursors freeze a result-count snapshot and are bound to action_id. Each result is immutable server-synchronized evidence published only after owned-menu cleanup; observed_client_tick and packet_revision describe the captured server snapshot, not present inventory or mutation authority. total_item_types, returned_item_types and truncated explicitly report completeness. All successful inspection occurrences (max 256 expanded nodes) are retained without eviction while the Action is retained; the store retains only the latest Action and previous terminal Action. Read all pages before starting further Actions. A missing result is not an empty chest; failed/unconfirmed inspections have no result. An empty verified chest has a result with items=[] and total_item_types=0. During execution, query again without a cursor for newly completed results. trace remains a short, possibly truncated summary; use container_results for complete inventories. Omission/false preserves the legacy output without container_results. Page-only arguments require the option to be true.

include_result.description: For v2 jobs, include the retained bounded result only when explicitly requested. Omission keeps progress polls small. Ignored for legacy v1 Actions.

wait_timeout_ms.description: Optional bounded terminal-state long poll. Zero or omission returns immediately; a non-terminal timeout returns the current snapshot with the unchanged output shape.

include_container_results.description: Return a page of complete immutable inspection results; omitted/false keeps the legacy output.

container_results_limit.description: Maximum containers per page; requires include_container_results=true.

container_results_cursor.description: Use next_cursor from the same action_id; requires include_container_results=true.

effectObservation.description: Bounded semantic observation only; raw menu slots, payloads, credentials, and secrets are never present.

displayed_item.description: Server-observed frame item; minecraft:air means a confirmed empty display. Omitted means unknown.

recoverable.description: True means fresh observation and replanning may recover. It never authorizes blind replay of the original Action.

effects.description: Bounded latest-effect ring recorded at authoritative observation/ACK points. Sequence numbers remain monotonic when earlier entries are evicted. An unknown entry means a mutation was dispatched but its after-state was not confirmed; it must never be replayed blindly. inventory_swap records an internal construction material exchange between main inventory and the selected hotbar: source/destination item and count refer to those two roles, never raw slot indices. Confirmed swaps conserve the items and are distinct from block placement. An interrupted unconfirmed swap has an empty observed_after and may reconcile later; reobserve before planning another action.

verification.description: Independent of terminal state. A confirmed effect remains committed even when the Action later fails or is cancelled and must be applied exactly once.

effect_aggregate.description: Fixed-size lifetime aggregate that remains complete when older effect-ring entries are evicted.

partial.description: Null while non-terminal. Every terminal result carries bounded interruption/resume metadata derived from the live ledger, never reconstructed after completion.

has_confirmed_effects.description: True when this terminal Action has one or more committed confirmed effects, including failed or cancelled Actions.

resume_requires_reobservation.description: When true, obtain fresh state or observation and plan a new Action. Do this even when every retained effect is confirmed; never replay the original Action blindly.

source.description: Canonical normalized Action DSL accepted for this action. It contains only caller-submitted, parser-recognized fields and never reflects secrets, hidden state, raw slots, or runtime-only data.

replayable.description: False whenever the retained source contains any opaque reference; use the redacted template and refresh every reference instead.

template.description: Safe clone template. Any opaque references and coupled recipe fingerprint are JSON null until replaced from a fresh producer result, making the template intentionally invalid for agent_start_action while blocked.

tools.name: agent_cancel_action
tools.title: Cancel MCMCP Action
tools.description: Idempotently requests cancellation of one explicit action handle.
